prompt: Where is my order? It's been 3 days.
response: I'm sorry for the wait. Orders usually reach metro cities in 2 to 4 business days. You can see the live status under My Orders, and the courier's tracking link is in your confirmation email. If it shows no movement for 48 hours, reply here and I'll raise a trace with the courier.

prompt: Can I change the delivery address after placing the order?
response: Yes, as long as the order has not been packed. Go to My Orders, open the order and choose Change Address. Once it is packed the address is locked, but you can ask the courier to redirect it from the tracking page.

prompt: How do I cancel an order?
response: Open My Orders, select the item and tap Cancel. Cancellation is free until the item ships. Prepaid orders are refunded to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.

prompt: My order shows delivered but I didn't get it.
response: I'm sorry about that. Please check with neighbours or your building security first, as couriers sometimes hand parcels to them. If you still can't find it within 24 hours, report it from My Orders > Not Received and we'll open an investigation with the courier. Most cases are resolved within 3 business days.

prompt: Do you deliver on Sundays?
response: Our courier partners deliver on Sundays in most metro cities. In other areas Sunday delivery depends on the local courier hub. The delivery estimate at checkout already accounts for this.

prompt: Can I get express delivery?
response: Express delivery is available for many pin codes for a fee of 99 rupees, and it is free for Volt Plus members. Enter your pin code on the product page to see whether express delivery is offered for that item.

prompt: Why was my order split into two shipments?
response: Items in one order sometimes ship from different warehouses so they reach you sooner. Each shipment has its own tracking link in My Orders. You are not charged extra delivery for the split.

prompt: What is your return policy for headphones?
response: Headphones and earbuds can be returned within 7 days of delivery if they are defective or not as described. For hygiene reasons, opened in-ear products can only be replaced, not refunded, unless they are faulty.

prompt: How do I return a laptop?
response: Laptops can be returned within 10 days of delivery for a defect or damage in transit. Start the request from My Orders > Return, keep the original box and accessories, and sign out of any accounts on the device. A technician visit may be scheduled to confirm the issue before pickup.

prompt: When will I get my refund?
response: Once the returned item passes the quality check, refunds are issued within 2 business days. Your bank or card issuer may take another 3 to 5 business days to show it. UPI refunds are usually faster.

prompt: The phone I received has a scratch on the screen.
response: I'm sorry the phone arrived like that. Please raise a return within 48 hours of delivery from My Orders and attach a photo of the scratch and the box. We'll arrange a free pickup and send a replacement once the pickup is done.

prompt: Can I exchange my TV for a bigger size?
response: Exchanges for a different size are possible within 7 days if the TV has not been installed. You pay the price difference, and we schedule pickup of the old unit when the new one is delivered.

prompt: Is the return pickup free?
response: Yes, return pickup is free for defective, damaged or wrong items. For change-of-mind returns on eligible products, a pickup fee of 49 rupees is deducted from the refund.

prompt: I lost the box. Can I still return the item?
response: We need the original packaging for most returns because it protects the product in transit. If the item is defective, contact us anyway: we can often arrange a replacement through a technician visit instead of a pickup.

prompt: How do I claim warranty on my air fryer?
response: Your air fryer has a 1-year manufacturer warranty. Find the warranty card or your Volt invoice in My Orders, then book a service request with the brand from the link on the invoice page. If you need help, I can share the brand's service number.

prompt: Does the warranty cover water damage?
response: Standard manufacturer warranties do not cover liquid or physical damage. If you bought Volt Protect with the device, accidental liquid damage is covered once during the plan period.

prompt: What is Volt Protect?
response: Volt Protect is an optional extended protection plan. It adds 1 or 2 years after the manufacturer warranty, and the accidental damage version also covers drops and spills once per year. It must be bought within 30 days of purchasing the device.

prompt: My earbuds stopped charging after 4 months.
response: That sounds like a fault covered by the 1-year warranty. Please try a different cable and clean the charging contacts first. If they still don't charge, raise a warranty request from My Orders and we'll arrange a replacement through the brand.

prompt: Can I transfer warranty to a new owner?
response: Manufacturer warranties usually stay with the device, so the new owner can claim with the original invoice. Volt Protect plans can be transferred once by contacting support with both owners' details.

prompt: Where is the nearest service centre?
response: You can find authorised service centres by brand and pin code on our Service Locator page. Most metro cities have a Volt Care centre that accepts laptops, phones and small appliances.

prompt: Do you offer no-cost EMI?
response: Yes, no-cost EMI is available on many products above 3000 rupees with major credit cards for 3, 6 or 9 months. Eligible options are shown at checkout. The bank may charge GST on the interest, which is then refunded as a discount.

prompt: My payment failed but money was deducted.
response: I'm sorry about the trouble. If a payment fails after debit, your bank usually reverses it automatically within 5 to 7 business days. If you don't see the reversal by then, share the transaction ID with us and we'll follow up with the payment gateway.

prompt: Can I pay with UPI?
response: Yes. We accept UPI, credit and debit cards, net banking and selected wallets. Cash on delivery is available for orders up to 10000 rupees in most areas.

prompt: How do I get a GST invoice?
response: Add your GSTIN at checkout under Use GST Invoice. The invoice with your business details will be available in My Orders after the item ships. Invoices can't be changed to GST after the order is placed.

prompt: Is cash on delivery available for a refrigerator?
response: Cash on delivery is available for orders up to 10000 rupees. For larger items like refrigerators you can pay online, choose EMI, or use pay on delivery with UPI at the doorstep in supported cities.

prompt: Can I use two cards for one order?
response: At the moment each order can be paid with one payment method. You can combine a Volt gift card with one other method, though.

prompt: Which laptop is good for college under 50000?
response: For college work in that budget, look for 16 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD and a recent Ryzen 5 or Core i5 processor. Use the filters on the laptops page to compare battery life and weight, which matter most if you carry it every day.

prompt: Does this phone support 5G?
response: You can check 5G support in the Specifications section of the product page under Network. Also confirm that your SIM plan and area have 5G coverage, since the phone alone is not enough.

prompt: What is the difference between QLED and OLED TVs?
response: OLED panels light each pixel on their own, so they show deeper blacks and better contrast in dark rooms. QLED panels use a backlight and get brighter, which helps in sunny rooms. Both are good; it mostly depends on your room and budget.

prompt: Is the 1.5 ton split AC enough for my room?
response: A 1.5 ton AC usually suits rooms of about 150 to 180 square feet. Top floors, west-facing rooms or many people in the room may need more capacity. Our AC page has a size guide if you share the room dimensions.

prompt: Does the smartwatch work with iPhone?
response: Compatibility is listed on the product page under Compatible Devices. Most fitness watches support both Android and iPhone through their app, but some features like replying to messages may be Android-only.

prompt: Is this refrigerator frost free?
response: The cooling type is shown in Specifications as Frost Free or Direct Cool. Frost free models defrost automatically; direct cool models are cheaper but need manual defrosting now and then.

prompt: Will this charger work with my phone?
response: Check that the charger's connector matches your phone, usually USB-C, and that both support the same fast-charging standard. A compatible charger is safe even at lower wattage; it just charges more slowly.

prompt: Is TV installation free?
response: Free installation is included for most TVs above 32 inches. A technician contacts you within 48 hours of delivery to schedule it. A wall mount bracket is included only if the product page says so.

prompt: When will the technician come to install my AC?
response: AC installation is usually scheduled within 48 hours of delivery. You'll get an SMS with the technician's details. Please note that copper pipe beyond 3 metres and stand charges are paid separately at the visit.

prompt: Can I reschedule the installation visit?
response: Yes. Use the link in the installation SMS or go to My Orders > Installation to choose a new slot. Rescheduling is free up to 2 hours before the visit.

prompt: The washing machine installation was not done properly.
response: I'm sorry about that. Please raise a complaint from My Orders > Installation > Report Issue and add a photo if possible. We'll send a senior technician at no cost, usually within 2 days.

prompt: Do you install ceiling fans?
response: Installation for ceiling fans is available in selected cities for a small fee shown at checkout. If it's not shown for your pin code, any licensed electrician can install it without affecting the warranty.

prompt: I forgot my password.
response: Tap Forgot Password on the login screen and enter your registered mobile number or email. You'll receive a one-time code to set a new password. Volt will never ask you for this code on a call.

prompt: How do I change my registered phone number?
response: Go to Account > Profile > Mobile Number and verify the new number with a one-time code. If you no longer have the old number, contact support with your email and an order ID so we can verify the account.

prompt: How do I delete my account?
response: You can request deletion under Account > Privacy > Delete Account. Pending orders and refunds must be completed first. Invoices are kept for the period required by tax law, but your profile and saved addresses are removed.

prompt: What are Volt Plus benefits?
response: Volt Plus members get free express delivery, early access to sales, and extra cashback on selected brands. Membership costs 499 rupees a year and can be cancelled at any time from Account > Membership.

prompt: I got a call asking for my OTP from Volt.
response: Please do not share the OTP. Volt support never asks for OTPs, card PINs or passwords on a call. If you shared it, change your password now and contact your bank. You can also report the number from Account > Report Fraud.

prompt: When is the next sale?
response: Sale dates are announced on the home page and in the app a few days before they start. Volt Plus members get early access. You can turn on sale alerts under Account > Notifications.

prompt: My coupon code is not working.
response: Coupons usually have a minimum order value, an expiry date and a list of eligible products. Check the coupon details in the Offers section. If it should apply and still doesn't, send me the code and I'll check it for you.

prompt: How does the exchange offer work for my old phone?
response: On the product page, choose Buy with Exchange and enter your old phone's model and condition. The exchange value is deducted at checkout, and the delivery partner checks the old phone when delivering the new one. If its condition differs, the value may be adjusted.

prompt: Will I get bank cashback on EMI?
response: Bank offers apply to EMI only when the offer says so. The eligible cards and the minimum amount are listed under Bank Offers at checkout. Cashback is usually credited within 90 days by the bank.

prompt: Do you have a student discount?
response: We run student offers on laptops and tablets a few times a year, verified with a college email ID. When one is live it appears in the Offers section of the app.

prompt: My laptop is very slow after the update.
response: Right after a big update, Windows often indexes files in the background for a few hours. Restart once, keep the charger connected, and check Windows Update for pending restarts. If it's still slow after a day, our tech support can run a remote check for free under warranty.

prompt: The TV has no sound.
response: Please check that the TV is not on mute and that the sound output is set to TV Speakers, not an external device, under Settings > Sound. Try another channel or app too. If there's still no sound, book a free warranty visit from My Orders.

prompt: Bluetooth earbuds won't connect to my phone.
response: Put both earbuds back in the case, then press and hold the case button for 10 seconds to reset them. Remove the old pairing from your phone's Bluetooth list and pair again. This fixes most connection problems.

prompt: My refrigerator is not cooling.
response: First check that the temperature is set to the middle setting and the vents inside are not blocked by food. Leave a 10 cm gap behind the fridge for air flow. If it doesn't cool within 24 hours, raise a service request and a technician will visit.

prompt: The washing machine shows error E21.
response: On most models E21 means the water is not draining. Clean the drain filter at the bottom front of the machine and check that the drain hose is not bent. If the error stays, please book a service visit and mention the error code.

prompt: My phone gets hot while charging.
response: Some warmth while fast charging is normal. Remove thick covers, avoid using heavy apps while charging, and use the original charger. If it becomes too hot to hold or the battery swells, stop using it and book a service check right away.

prompt: Do you have a store in Pune?
response: You can find Volt stores near you on our Store Locator page by entering your city or pin code. It shows opening hours and which stores offer same-day pickup.

prompt: Can I pick up my order from a store?
response: Yes, choose Store Pickup at checkout if it's available for your pin code. You'll get an SMS when the order is ready, and you have 5 days to collect it with your order ID and a photo ID.

prompt: What are your customer support hours?
response: Chat support is available 24 hours a day. Phone support runs from 8 am to 10 pm every day, including Sundays.

prompt: How can I talk to a human agent?
response: Type Agent at any time in this chat and I'll connect you with a support executive. Current wait time is usually under 5 minutes. You can also call us between 8 am and 10 pm.

prompt: Do you offer bulk orders for offices?
response: Yes, Volt Business handles bulk orders of laptops, monitors and accessories with GST invoices and volume pricing. Fill in the form on the Volt Business page and a sales manager will contact you within one working day.

prompt: Can I buy refurbished laptops?
response: Yes, Volt Renewed sells certified refurbished laptops and phones. Each one is tested, graded by condition and comes with a 6-month warranty. The grade and what it means are shown on each product page.
